name: Raster Blaster Demo (WebGL Optimized)
author: Mikhailzrick
description:
I hope you enjoy my first game! Raster Blaster is an arcade style wave shooter with heavy synthwave / 80's vibes! This is a demo of the first level. 

Shoot opposite color projectiles to damage enemies!  There's also a hidden secret item if you can find it. :)

Lets see those high scores!
